dedupe_keys.name: agriedge leakage free precision agriculture iiot intrusion detection benchmark rebuilt from edge iiotset

description: A benchmark of industrial IoT traffic for precision agriculture, rebuilt from the raw per-device captures of Edge-IIoTset with a single parser. The Zenodo record says the curated Edge-IIoTset subsets carry a serialisation artefact, where missing protocol fields are written as 0 in normal captures and 0.0 in attack captures, so four columns reveal the label on their own; after the rebuild no column separates the classes at better than 0.6179 single-column accuracy. The table has 1,276,122 rows and 53 columns: 49 protocol features stored as text, an attack label (751,559 normal and 524,563 attack rows), 15 attack types, 19 source devices and a source layer (perception, actuation or adversary). It warns that random splits overstate performance, since a random forest falls from 0.9988 to 0.5083 balanced accuracy when the Modbus gateway is held out. Version 1.0.0 was published on 15 August 2026 as a downloadable Parquet file of 38.4 MB with a README, under the MIT licence, with code on GitHub; the source data are free for academic use. Coverage is one testbed. Caveats: derived data, and the upstream licence limits use. For simulation it tests attack detection on farm sensors and actuators before modelling cyber disruption of irrigation or machinery. A related catalogue record is the Farm-Flow AG-IoT intrusion detection dataset.
